name: Predictive Buffer
description: Buffers clicks for a configurable number of physics ticks so they fire the moment you touch an orb. F6 cycles the buffer window (max 120 ticks).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for the predictive buffer.

tick-window.name: Buffer window (ticks)
tick-window.description: How many physics ticks a click stays buffered. Press F6 in-game to cycle through presets (1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 60, 90, 120).
